selection.basis: B60 checked 25 image resources and B65 checked 10 additional image records. This is the only current image-health gap not included in either frozen set; one exact endpoint check closes the remaining untested image batch without exceeding the per-writer limit.
previous_batches: B60: 25 remote image resources, all unreachable without HTTP status or content type
B65: 10 remote image resources, all unreachable without HTTP status or content type

runtime_check.acceptance: Only a current HTTP 2xx/3xx response with image/* content type and a matching URL supports a healthy_check record. Host-blocked or unreachable results do not prove that the remote image is broken.
runtime_check.no_copy: Do not download, mirror, or otherwise copy the image.

done_criteria: Run one image-health report for the one frozen image ID.
If healthy, record the exact status, content type, URL and check date; run coverage acceptance and the full repository gate once for the image-record change.
If blocked or unreachable without HTTP status/content type, preserve image records and record the bounded result without calling the image broken.
Do not run another report in this batch and do not inspect or copy image contents.
Local B66 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication or production action.
delivery: Local B66 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication or production action.
